instruction: Search for hotels in Lisbon and sort the results by lowest price.

criteria.script: (()=>{const L=['Our top picks','Lowest price first','Star rating and price','Top reviewed'];const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x=>L.includes(x.textContent.trim())).find(x=>x.className.includes('bg-booking-blue'));return b?b.textContent.trim():null;})()
